quick_answer: Draw the lot outline on the map by placing its corners, then read the spherical polygon area and perimeter. This workspace measures a drawn outline; it does not ask for a rectangular length and width. A mapped estimate cannot establish a legal parcel boundary.
steps_intro: Use the controls in the workspace, then check the interpretation and limitations below.

use_cases.title: Inspect the result before reusing it

body.t: Draw the lot outline on the map by placing its corners, then read the spherical polygon area and perimeter. This workspace measures a drawn outline; it does not ask for a rectangular length and width. A mapped estimate cannot establish a legal parcel boundary. Record the input and mode with any exported or reported result.

For a reproducible small test near the Equator, enter corners 0,0; 0,0.001; 0.001,0.001; 0.001,0. The spherical model gives about 12,364 m² (about 3.06 acres). Move a vertex and the area should change; these coordinates do not represent a surveyed lot.
